summary: Implemented the bounded Career World tracer as the root route, then applied the bounded review fixes. The immutable registry preserves all accepted world and NinjaOne local coordinates, keeps unfrozen Kaizen Metrics links as position-null placeholder instances, and validates exact city/project/skill ownership. The semantic surface keeps employer controls on mobile, returns focus to the visible invoking control, and opens the factual drawer only for Kaizen Metrics. This is deterministic placeholder geometry, not concept-art fidelity.

claims.claim: The registry is frozen at 1600 by 900, contains all five employer anchors and accepted NinjaOne local tuples, validates exactly one city per employer and one asset/instance per project, and enforces unique city skill placement across placed and placeholder instances.
claims.evidence: Frozen coordinate tuples start at lines 173-187; validateCareerWorldRegistry at lines 273-361 checks unique assets/instances, city counts, project counts, skill placement, links, and tuple drift.

claims.claim: Camera zoom is anchor-preserving and LOD is a pure visibility classification, so it cannot mutate registry tuples.
claims.evidence: worldToScreen, screenToWorld, zoomCameraAt, and lodForZoom are isolated pure helpers at lines 22-67.

claims.claim: The drawer sources Kaizen Metrics only from the existing evidence trace and ordered evidence records.
claims.evidence: getKaizenMetricsEvidence resolves traceById and recordsForTrace directly; the registry does not supply factual drawer fields.

claims.claim: URL IDs are validated against registry maps, invalid state falls back to world, and only engineering-metrics-pipeline can open the factual drawer; other NinjaOne projects still retain their normal focus and URL state.
claims.evidence: resolveCareerWorldUrlState validates project/employer IDs at lines 24-31; drawerProjectForFocus at lines 75-84 gates the drawer to METRICS_DRAWER_PROJECT_ID; URL focus updates remain at lines 112-134.

claims.claim: Decorative visuals remain one aria-hidden SVG while semantic controls expose employers, projects, mobile selection, back/reset/zoom, and the drawer restores focus to an HTMLElement invoker; mobile keeps employer controls visible.
claims.evidence: career-world.tsx lines 14-15 retain HTMLElement invokers; world-hit-targets.tsx lines 7 and 53-61 pass the visible select currentTarget; career-world.css line 52 keeps the employer section visible at the phone breakpoint.

claims.claim: Both project suites run as part of npm test and explicitly cover all SSR labels, registry/camera invariants, Metrics-only drawer eligibility/dismissal, adapter reuse, and mobile source contracts.
claims.evidence: The test command includes both suites; tests/career-world.test.mjs lines 19-202 define the new coverage.
